clue.text: Sudden onset of snow producing white water

parts.note: rapid means quick or sudden

indicators.note: the onset of a word is its beginning, so take the opening letter of snow

explanation.surface: A sudden snowfall turns a river into foaming white water.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapids are stretches of fast, turbulent river where the surface foams white.

clue.text: Barrie's play transposed for another girl

indicators.note: transposed means the two halves of the title swap places

parts.note: Mary Rose is a play by J. M. Barrie

explanation.surface: Barrie's play is reworked to feature a different girl.
explanation.walkthrough: Mary Rose is also a girl's name, so 'another girl' is a nice touch.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosemary is a girl's name, as the play title is itself.

clue.text: Safe man gave signal from bridge

parts.note: peter is old slang for a safe
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: A safe-cracker signals from the ship's bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridge is the card game: to peter is to signal by playing a high card then a low one.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, to peter is to give a conventional high-low signal to one's partner.

clue.text: Specially emphasise campaign on environment

parts.note: a drive is a campaign
home means one's environment or habitat

explanation.surface: Press the message about an environmental campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: To press a point home is to stress it forcefully.

clue.text: Volunteer about to kill criminal

indicators.note: about means going around, so the synonym for volunteer is placed around the other piece

parts.note: to volunteer is to offer
to end something is to kill it off

explanation.surface: Someone volunteers just before committing murder, a criminal in the making.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is a person who breaks the law, a lawbreaker.

clue.text: It makes it difficult to lift cold meat

definitions.text: It makes it difficult to lift

parts.note: frozen means very cold
shoulder is a cut of meat

explanation.surface: A frozen joint of meat is hard to lift.
explanation.definitionFit: This stiff, painful joint condition restricts raising the arm.

clue.text: Fast days not observed in Nov.

definitions.note: the answer is used attributively in Ember days, so these words define it in that phrase

indicators.note: the abbreviation shows only part of the month, so what is not seen in it is the rest of the full word

parts.note: Nov. is the abbreviation for November

explanation.surface: Fasting days are not kept in November.
explanation.walkthrough: The month is printed shortened; the letters not shown are the hidden remainder after NOV.
explanation.definitionFit: Ember days are quarterly periods of fasting and prayer in the church calendar.

clue.text: Understand almost everything about some computers

definitions.note: digital is an adjective describing a kind of computer

parts.note: dig it is slang for understand or appreciate

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word for everything is dropped

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: Grasp nearly all there is to know about some computers.
explanation.definitionFit: Digital computers process data as discrete numbers, unlike analogue machines.

clue.text: Take up again "The Sad End of Uncle Remus"

indicators.note: sad here signals a sorry, messed-up state of the letters, so they are rearranged
end of means the final letter of uncle is taken

explanation.surface: A story title about the sad death of Uncle Remus.
explanation.walkthrough: Uncle Remus is the storyteller of Joel Chandler Harris's folk tales.
explanation.definitionFit: To resume is to restart or continue after a pause.

clue.text: Short history in novel form

definitions.meaning: Gibbon's History of the ... of the Roman Empire, by its short title

explanation.surface: A brief history written up as a novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Gibbon's great history is known by this short title, and Waugh's 1928 novel shares it.

clue.text: Inflame quarrel about cashier

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for quarrel goes around the word for cashier

parts.note: a set-to is a fight or quarrel
to cashier someone is to dismiss them, to fire them

explanation.surface: A row breaks out over a bank cashier and tempers flare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cashier' looks like a bank clerk but is the verb meaning to dismiss from service, as with an officer.
explanation.definitionFit: To inflame something can literally mean to make it burn, i.e. kindle it.

clue.text: False return admitted by public transport

annotationWithheld.why: False return admitted by public transport (5): BOGUS is BUS around OG, GO backwards, but no clue word gives GO apart from 'return', which would be both the fodder and the reversal indicator.
annotationWithheld.clue: False return admitted by public transport

clue.text: Poet regarded as genius by sovereign

parts.note: a person regarded as a genius is called a marvel
a sovereign is a gold pound coin, and L is the abbreviation for pound

explanation.surface: A poet is hailed as a genius by the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is an old British gold coin worth one pound, and the pound is abbreviated L (from Latin libra).
explanation.definitionFit: Andrew Marvell was a seventeenth-century English metaphysical poet.

clue.text: Mistake that may give rise to another slip?

definitions.text: Mistake that may give rise to another slip?

parts.words: Mistake that may give rise to another slip?
parts.note: a printing error in a book is corrected by an inserted slip of paper listing it, so one slip (error) leads to another slip (paper)

explanation.surface: One blunder leads to another.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin word names an error in printing or writing, especially one listed for correction.

clue.text: It generates waves — a large number — in port

indicators.note: in means the pieces are placed inside the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian port
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

explanation.surface: Something that makes waves arrives in a port in large numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A transmitter set generates radio waves, electromagnetic signals for broadcasting.

clue.text: Openings under bridge that may get blocked during cold spell

definitions.text: Openings under bridge that may get blocked during cold spell

parts.words: Openings under bridge that may get blocked during cold spell
parts.note: the bridge is that of the nose, beneath which are two openings that get stuffed up when one has a cold

explanation.surface: Arches under a river bridge get choked with ice in a freeze.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the two external openings of the nose, sitting below its bridge and blocked by a head cold.

clue.text: Countered tangled reeds round lake

indicators.note: round means the jumbled letters surround the word for lake
tangled means the letters are jumbled

parts.note: a pond is a small lake

explanation.surface: Reeds are tangled around a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tangled' gives RESED, which 'round' splits around POND.
explanation.definitionFit: To respond is to reply or answer back, much as to counter.

clue.text: Affirmed again the country is in debt

indicators.note: is in means placed inside the word for debt

parts.note: in the red means in debt
a state is a country or nation

explanation.surface: The nation reaffirms that it is in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Restated means said once more, declared a second time.

clue.text: Not caught in motorcade moving at a reasonable pace

indicators.note: moving signals that the remaining letters are rearranged
not means the letter for caught is left out of the procession's name

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Free of the traffic, a motorcade travels at a sensible speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not caught in' removes C from MOTORCADE, leaving MOTORADE, which 'moving' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderato is the musical tempo marking for a moderate speed.

clue.text: After leading soldier goes out, military exercise works

indicators.note: goes out means the soldier's word is removed from the exercise word

parts.note: manoeuvres are military exercises
a man is an ordinary soldier, here leading as he is at the front of the word

explanation.surface: After the commanding soldier leaves, a military exercise goes ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' is a link; 'leading' places the soldier at the head of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Oeuvres are an artist's or writer's works, the French word for them.

clue.text: Composer drank almost to the end

indicators.note: almost to the end means stopping just short, so the final letter is removed

parts.note: supped means drank

explanation.surface: A composer drinks nearly to the bottom of the glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz von Suppé was an Austrian composer of operettas and overtures such as Light Cavalry.

clue.text: Throw out beetle

definitions.meaning: to beetle is to jut out or overhang, as beetling brows

explanation.surface: Get rid of an insect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beetle' looks like the insect but is the verb meaning to overhang.
explanation.definitionFit: To project means to cast forward and also to stick out, as a beetling cliff does.

clue.text: Sanctuary unknown in a squalid neighbourhood

indicators.note: in means the unknown is placed inside the other words

parts.note: a slum is a squalid neighbourhood
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A sanctuary nobody knows of sits in a rundown district.
explanation.definitionFit: Asylum is protection or refuge offered to the persecuted.

clue.text: Walked stiffly out, in a way

definitions.meaning: to stump is to walk heavily and stiffly
in cricket a batsman is out ... when the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while he is out of his ground

explanation.surface: Someone stalks off stiffly, dismissed in some manner.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket is a British bat-and-ball game; being stumped is one of its ways of being out.
explanation.definitionFit: Stumping along means walking stiffly and noisily; stumping is also a cricket dismissal.

clue.text: Composition's harmony appreciated by audience

indicators.note: an audience takes in what it hears, so the word sounds the same as another

parts.note: peace means harmony

explanation.surface: The harmony of a composition is enjoyed by those listening.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece is a musical work or composition.

clue.text: Pay attention to your own business

definitions.meaning: to be watchful and pay attention
saying something is your ... means it is your own concern

explanation.surface: Mind your step, and keep to your own affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Watching out means being alert; and the idiom 'that's your lookout' means it is your own concern.

clue.text: Elgar's monumental variation

indicators.note: a variation is a changed form, so the name's letters are rearranged

parts.note: the composer's name taken as written, the possessive adding no letter

explanation.surface: One of Elgar's Enigma Variations is a monumental work.
explanation.walkthrough: Elgar is famous for the Enigma Variations, which makes 'variation' read as music.
explanation.definitionFit: Something monumental is huge in size, so very big.

clue.text: Improvement as aim embraced by American people? Precisely!

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
men means people
to a T means precisely, giving T

explanation.surface: An improvement as American citizens aim for, and exactly so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Precisely' gives T from the phrase 'to a T'; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is a change that betters something, such as to a law or text.

clue.text: Caused confusion among the deck hands

definitions.text: Caused confusion among the deck hands

parts.words: Caused confusion among the deck hands
parts.note: deck hands reads as sailors but means hands of cards from a deck, muddled by a wrong distribution

explanation.surface: Someone threw the ship's crew into chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal cards wrongly gives players incorrect hands, a card-game blunder.

clue.text: Cleaned up and polished, as it happens? No

definitions.meaning: text that has been revised and tidied
a broadcast that is not live as it happens has been cut and prepared beforehand

explanation.surface: A tidied-up report, not quite as events unfolded.
explanation.definitionFit: Edited text has been revised for publication; an edited broadcast is recorded and cut rather than live.
